description: This file implements route access control checks for various API endpoints in a FastAPI-based project. It defines methods for verifying whether a route can be called based on user roles, route patterns, and specific route attributes, including special handling for management and openai-related routes. It also includes utility functions for masking user IDs and checking route match patterns.

classes.name: RouteChecks
classes.description: A utility class encapsulating static methods to perform various route access and validation checks within the application.

methods.name: should_call_route(route: str, valid_token: UserAPIKeyAuth)
methods.description: Checks if the management route is enabled, calls enterprise-specific route checks if applicable, and verifies virtual key permissions.

methods.name: bool is_virtual_key_allowed_to_call_route( route: str, valid_token: UserAPIKeyAuth )
methods.description: Verifies whether a virtual API key is permitted to call the specified route based on allowed routes, route patterns, and special route categories.

methods.name: str _mask_user_id(user_id: str)
methods.description: Masks user ID to prevent sensitive data leakage, showing only the first 2 and last 2 characters unless ID is very short.

methods.name: None _raise_admin_only_route_exception( user_obj: Optional[LiteLLM_UserTable], route: str, )
methods.description: Raises an exception when a route requiring admin privileges is accessed by unauthorized users, including masking user ID in message.

methods.name: non_proxy_admin_allowed_routes_check( user_obj: Optional[LiteLLM_UserTable], _user_role: Optional[LitellmUserRoles], route: str, request: Request, valid_token: UserAPIKeyAuth, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Performs access validation for non-proxy admin users, checking roles, specific routes (info, spend, etc.), and permissions.

methods.name: custom_admin_only_route_check(route: str)
methods.description: Checks if route is an admin-only route defined in enterprise settings, raising exception if insecure access is attempted.

methods.name: bool is_llm_api_route(route: str)
methods.description: Determines if the route is associated with OpenAI-like or LLM API endpoints.

methods.name: bool _is_azure_openai_route(route: str)
methods.description: Checks if the route corresponds to an Azure OpenAI deployment based on route pattern.

methods.name: bool _route_matches_pattern(route: str, pattern: str)
methods.description: Checks if a route matches a pattern with placeholders, e.g., /threads/{thread_id}.

methods.name: bool _is_wildcard_pattern(pattern: str)
methods.description: Determines whether a given pattern is a wildcard pattern (ends with '*').

methods.name: bool _route_matches_wildcard_pattern(route: str, pattern: str)
methods.description: Checks if a route matches a wildcard pattern.

methods.name: bool _route_matches_allowed_route(route: str, allowed_route: str)
methods.description: Verifies if a route matches an allowed route pattern, including exact and prefix matches.

methods.name: bool check_route_access(route: str, allowed_routes: List[str])
methods.description: Checks if a route is permitted based on a list of allowed routes and patterns.

methods.name: bool check_passthrough_route_access( route: str, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth )
methods.description: Determines if a route is a valid passthrough route based on API key metadata.

methods.name: bool _is_assistants_api_request(request: Request)
methods.description: Detects if the request path contains keywords indicating an assistant or thread API request.

methods.name: bool is_generate_content_route(route: str)
methods.description: Checks if the route is related to Google's generateContent or streamGenerateContent endpoints.

methods.name: None _check_proxy_admin_viewer_access( route: str, _user_role: str, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Validates access for proxy admin view-only roles, restricting certain routes and operations.

ctags.name: check_route_access
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_route_access(route: str, allowed_routes: List[str]) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: non_proxy_admin_allowed_routes_check
ctags.signature: ( user_obj: Optional[LiteLLM_UserTable], _user_role: Optional[LitellmUserRoles], route: str, request: Request, valid_token: UserAPIKeyAuth, request_data: dict, )
